If Priya isn't showing in your contact list, try this:

1. Go to **Contacts**.
2. Type her name in the search box. It matches name, email address and phone number.
3. Check the **Company** and **Status** filters next to the search box, as they may be hiding her.
4. Select **Clear filters** to show every contact again.

Also note that this is a demonstration copy: reloading the page resets all contacts to the original sample data, so any contact you added earlier will be gone.
